did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A pre-order that came from an MPO was waiting for its goods on the owner's pre-orders page. First Napa's stock was read (18 boxes). The owner typed the discount paid to the MPO (12%) and pressed "Goods reached me". The stock page was opened again.

checks.text: The card says "From an MPO. When the goods reach you, put them into stock at the discount you paid." and has a "Discount you paid (%)" box and "Goods reached me"
The page confirms: "The goods are in stock now. You can receive the order."
Napa goes from 18 to 19 boxes, in a new lot with source "Through MPO", cost 264.00 a unit, 12% below the printed price of 300

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

shots.caption: Before: Napa has 18 boxes on hand
The owner types the discount paid (12%) before pressing Goods reached me
After: a new lot, Through MPO, 12% below the printed price
